label: Figure 5.5: The supply of tennis rackets
alt: A single upward-sloping supply curve for tennis rackets with a movement down along it as price falls from P to P1, cutting quantity supplied from Q to Q1.
caption: A fall in the price of tennis rackets from P to P<sub>1</sub> causes a movement down along the supply curve S. Quantity supplied contracts from Q to Q<sub>1</sub>, and the curve itself does not move.
